body:

subject: A hands-on AI session for your team
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

name: XamBaaz — Principal Intro
subject: XamBaaz Quiz Challenge for your Class 9 and 11 students
body:
Dear Principal,

I'm Bithin, founder of XamBaaz. I'd like to invite your school to the XamBaaz National Quiz Challenge, an online, timed quiz for Classes 9 and 11 that shows students how ready they are for JEE, NEET and other entrance exams.

Every participant gets a free preparedness score with a breakdown of strengths and weak areas. Top scorers win Amazon vouchers and a year of XamBaaz Premium.

It runs fully online, so it needs very little from your staff.

Could we find 15 minutes this week to set it up for your students?

Warm regards,
Bithin
